evidence.locator: Sect. I: in Paper I the inner shell is tilted by 9 degrees to the line of sight with a position angle of 25 degrees and has a width to length ratio of about 1.8. Sect. V: the ratio between the inner shell's major and minor axes is 1.8; distance 1300 pc from the inner shell's proper motions and radial velocities.

table3.dat, 536 records: X and Y of each structure from the central star in arcsec, its proper motion in pixels and km/s (two WFPC2 [N II] images 7.695 yr apart), and its radial velocity in km/s from high-resolution spectra.
